entries.en: to imprison; to jail
entries.notes: L 与 H「囚」义合；惟 M 读 liū 与全页其余「囚」作 fīn 者不合（音近「留」），R 读 chên 亦非常读，四栏未能完全互证。

entries.zh: 监禁；关押（「監」兼指牢狱与监禁）
entries.en: to imprison; to jail; to hold in a prison
entries.notes: 「監」单字可指牢狱并作监禁解；M 栏作 lī ca 两音节且带[疑:l/m]，首音节来源不明，姑取「监禁」义。

entries.en: to confine; to imprison; to detain
entries.notes: M、R 两栏并作 guîn，与「禁」常读不合，字符或为形近之「圄」类字；据 L「encarcelar」取拘禁义。

entries.en: imprisonment; jail
entries.notes: 「囚監」为囚系与牢狱之合称；M 第二音节标[疑:cā/ca]，R 作 chên guiên 尚可通。

entries.en: to imprison (in a military lock-up); to confine
entries.notes: 「軍」与 encarcelar 义不相属；同组「軍禁」「放腳軍裡」「腳軍」并见，当指军牢或枷械一类拘禁处，二字读音亦并标[疑]，语义难定。

entries.en: to put the foot into the stocks; to lock someone's feet in the stocks
entries.notes: 「放腳……裡」即把脚纳入「軍」所指械具，与第 9 条 cepo（脚枷）同组；M、R 末音节并标[疑]。

entries.zh: 因讼系狱；讼狱（诉讼与刑狱）
entries.en: to be jailed in a lawsuit; litigation and imprisonment
entries.notes: 「訟獄」为诉讼、刑狱之合称，与动词 encarcelar 相接，取「因讼下狱」义；M、R 读音分属两系。

entries.en: to hold in secure confinement; to jail and keep closely guarded
entries.notes: L「y estar mui seguro」与 H「軍禁」相合；M 栏末 prendere le 系西语注记（「捉拿他」），非闽南语，不参与释义。

entries.zh: 上脚枷；使双脚夹锁于枷中
entries.en: to put (someone) in the stocks; to lock the feet in the cepo

entries.zh: 将官员下于天牢；把官押入大狱
entries.en: to imprison mandarins in the imperial gaol (tianlao)

entries.zh: 囚禁；因本人罪责而下狱
entries.en: to imprison for one's own fault; to jail on one's own guilt
prisoner; convict (one jailed for his own offense)
entries.notes: H「囚犯」为名词而 L 为动词短语，词性不齐；据「por su culpa」取「因己罪系狱者」。

entries.zh: 因死罪而囚禁；系狱待死
entries.en: to imprison for a capital offense; to jail for a crime deserving death
entries.notes: 「囚罪」非习见合成词，据 L「culpa de muerte」（死罪）与 R 读 chuī（罪）定作因死罪系狱。

entries.en: to take on (a task or office); to undertake
entries.notes: M 首音标[疑:fām/tām]，R 作 tâm（擔）可定；L「como oficio」与「擔」之承担义相合。

entries.en: to undertake; to take charge of (a matter)
entries.notes: H 栏标[疑:忍/任]；L「encargarse」及 M、R 读 xîm（任）皆指「任」，非「忍」。

entries.en: to take on an office; to shoulder a duty
entries.notes: off° 为 oficio（职务）之缩略；H「擔帶」当读作「擔戴」（担负），与「encargarse de algún oficio」相合。

entries.en: to take charge of an office; to assume a duty
entries.notes: M 首音标[疑:tām/fām]，R 作 tâm 可定；「擔當」与 oficio 义正合。

entries.en: to bear; to take upon oneself (a duty)
entries.notes: R 栏标[疑:sîn/siū]，M 读 sīū（受）可证为「受」；「擔受」即担承、承受。

entries.en: to undertake; to take on (an office)
entries.notes: H 作「擔成」，而 M 读 sēng、R 读 chêng 并为「承」之音，当系「擔承」之通写。

entries.en: to become dear; (of goods) to rise in price
entries.notes: H「價上」义明；M 作 què chiōm、R 作 guiā fāng，两栏对音不一且并标[疑]，读音存疑而义可定。
